invariants.rationale: From the implementation, result is the sum of padLeft and padRight obtained via the get method for actor.
Since padRight.get(actor) is added to padLeft.get(actor), the result is always greater than or equal to padLeft.get(actor) if padRight.get(actor) is non-negative.
Similarly, result is always greater than or equal to padRight.get(actor) if padLeft.get(actor) is non-negative.
If both paddings are non-negative, the sum is non-negative.
According to the Javadoc, result should be equal to getPadLeft() + getPadRight().
